title: Requests for a CD player
summary: Feedback centers on customers wanting a factory or optional CD player, with a small number of otherwise favorable reviews mentioning the missing feature.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle overall while also expressing appreciation for past or desired CD player availability.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly state a desire for a CD player or disappointment that it was removed, without enough context to label overall sentiment toward the vehicle.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are brief feature requests, so there is limited context for determining overall sentiment.
The examples focus narrowly on CD player availability and do not provide enough detail to assess broader infotainment performance or representative customer priorities.
